name: chart_generate
description: Generate charts and data visualizations. Creates PNG/SVG from data using matplotlib.

manual.overview: Use when you need to create charts (bar, line, pie, scatter, histogram) from data. Outputs PNG or SVG for reports or dashboards.

examples.description: Create a bar chart of regional sales
Line chart with default output path

tips: Match labels and values array lengths; mismatches cause errors
Use bar for categories, line for time series, pie for proportions, scatter for correlations
Set output_path to a writable location; default is chart.png
Ensure values are numeric; strings will fail
edge_cases: Empty labels or values will produce empty or broken charts
Very large datasets may slow rendering; consider aggregating first
Pie charts with many slices become unreadable; limit to 5-7 slices
